scope: Historical Runtime headers with the same current GPU backend on each host; not a full historical repository rebuild. Three fresh-process samples per configuration, except the final RTX 4060 MLP comparison uses a separate seven-repeat run. The initial three-repeat MLP samples are retained as pilot evidence and excluded from final MLP medians. Eager online excludes upfront preparation; Waterline online includes runtime preparation. All timings include final synchronization/drain. Keys and input encryption are excluded.
